cashRounding is NOT set and must not be guessed; it is measured from a real board against real futures. lat/lon is the centroid of the town's ZIP and can be miles from the yard.

THE RESIDUALS THIS RUN MEASURED, once the futures column is read as dollars: -0.25c x2, +0.25c x1, +0.5c x2. That is the evidence for cashRounding and it is NOT a declaration -- the modes differ at their boundaries and this many rows cannot tell them apart. cashRounding is round-cent-either, measured 2026-10-02 on the first live poll (run 37056777079): 5 row(s) refused under exact with residuals (cents) {-0.25: 2, +0.25: 1, +0.5: 2}, nothing outside +/-0.5. The 40 other sources on this vendor declare round-cent-both, which is wider.
